title: QA generation output
description: Shape an LLM must return for a Quantitative Aptitude question. The model returns a JSON ARRAY of these. Normalised into ../../schema.json for storage.

question.description: Full, self-contained question text with all data.

solution.description: Step-by-step worked solution with correct arithmetic.

shortcut.description: A faster CAT approach, or empty string if none.

subtopic.description: Optional finer classification, e.g. 'Successive Percentage Change'.

reference.description: Citation for the anchor it was modeled on, e.g. 'Modeled on CAT 2025 Slot 2'; empty for pure AI-generation.
